About the Author
Dr. Tasha McCray, PhD

Dr. Tasha McCray is a 2x bestselling author, the founder of the Wealth Caddie Movement, and the host of the TMac Inspired podcast. She has 31 years of nursing experience and 29 years as an entrepreneur. She is the founder of CompliTrst, a compliance technology company, and the Dr. TMac Foundation -- a charitable trust providing golf access and wealth education to Black girls under twelve.
